items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was with Ella Fitzgerald and Tony Bennett. So he was never in New York.

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s many years later. He had – when I moved to New York, he was always on the road, traveling. He was with Ella Fitzgerald and Tony Bennett. So he was never in New York. When I finally got to hear him, I was – yeah, I was floored. And he was such a nice cat – gentleman. When I moved to New York, I remember going to the Five Spot. One of the first people I met was Doug Watkins. He said to me, “Wow, man, you look like Tommy Flanagan with hair.” Of course I don’t have any hair now. So that was – I said,…
I got the look. Since you are writing and now arranging, do you have any influences that you can credit as far as your conceptions at that point?
